# Proverbs 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Scales-of deceit [are an]-abomination-of YHWH, but-a-weight complete [is] His-delight.

**2** Comes pride, then-comes disgrace, but-with [the]-humble [is] wisdom.

**3** Integrity-of [the]-upright guides-them, but-[the]-crookedness-of [the]-treacherous destroys-them.

**4** Not will-profit wealth in-[the]-day-of wrath, but-righteousness delivers from-death.

**5** Righteousness-of [the]-blameless makes-straight his-way, but-by-his-[own]-wickedness [the]-wicked will-fall.

**6** Righteousness-of [the]-upright delivers-them, but-by-[their]-desire [the]-treacherous are-captured.

**7** When-dies a-man wicked, [his]-hope perishes, and-expectation-of powers is-lost.

**8** [The]-righteous from-distress is-delivered, and-[the]-wicked comes in-his-place.

**9** With-[the]-mouth [the]-godless destroys his-neighbor, but-by-knowledge [the]-righteous are-delivered.

**10** When-it-goes-well-with [the]-righteous the-city rejoices, and-when-[the]-wicked perish [there is]-joyful-shouting.

**11** By-[the]-blessing-of [the]-upright a-city is-exalted, but-by-[the]-mouth-of [the]-wicked it-is-torn-down.

**12** One-despising his-neighbor lacks heart, but-a-man-of understanding keeps-silent.

**13** One-walking [as]-slander reveals secrets, but-[one]-faithful-of spirit conceals a-matter.

**14** Where-there-is-no guidance a-people falls, but-salvation [is] in-[the]-multitude-of counselors.

**15** Evil he-will-be-treated-evil when-he-puts-up-surety [for]-a-stranger, but-one-hating pledges is-secure.

**16** A-woman-of grace obtains honor, and-ruthless-ones obtain wealth.

**17** A-man-of lovingkindness benefits his-[own]-soul, but-[the]-cruel-one troubles his-[own]-flesh.

**18** [The]-wicked earns wages-of falsehood, but-one-sowing righteousness [has] a-reward-of truth.

**19** Genuine righteousness [leads] to-life, but-one-pursuing evil [goes] to-his-death.

**20** [An]-abomination-of YHWH [are the]-perverse-of heart, but-His-delight [are the]-blameless-of way.

**21** Hand to-hand [the]-evil-one will-not-go-unpunished, but-[the]-seed-of [the]-righteous is-delivered.

**22** A-ring-of gold in-[the]-snout-of a-pig — a-woman beautiful and-turning-from discretion.

**23** [The]-desire-of [the]-righteous [is] only good; [the]-expectation-of [the]-wicked [is] wrath.

**24** There-is one-scattering and-yet-increasing-more, and-one-withholding from-uprightness only to-lack.

**25** A-soul-of blessing will-be-made-fat, and-one-watering — also he will-be-watered.

**26** One-withholding grain — the-people will-curse-him, but-blessing [is] for-[the]-head-of one-selling.

**27** One-seeking good seeks favor, but-one-searching-for evil — it-will-come-to-him.

**28** One-trusting in-his-riches — he will-fall, but-like-foliage [the]-righteous will-flourish.

**29** One-troubling his-house will-inherit wind, and-a-fool [will be]-servant to-[the]-wise-of heart.

**30** [The]-fruit-of [the]-righteous [is] a-tree-of life, and-one-taking souls [is] wise.

**31** Behold, [the]-righteous in-the-earth will-be-repaid; how-much-more [the]-wicked and-[the]-sinner.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **11:1**: Mo'zenei mirmah — 'scales of deceit.' Commercial ethics feature prominently in Proverbs. Honest weights are a covenant obligation (Lev 19:36).

- **11:2**: One of the most compact proverbs. Ba zadon wayavo qalon — 'comes pride, comes disgrace.' The Hebrew uses identical verb forms for both.

- **11:22**: Nezem zahav be'af chazir — strikingly vivid. The absurdity of gold in a pig's snout mirrors beauty without discretion.

— EMET
